newsitem.title: USA: Anheuser-Busch Cos Inc Q4 oper profit.
newsitem.headline: Anheuser-Busch Cos Inc Q4 oper profit.

text.p: (All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)
NOTE: Q4 1996 revenues reflect gross sales before excise taxes of $407.0 million vs year-ago taxes of $368.6 million.
Q4 1996 net sales $2.49 billion vs $2.23 billion.
1995 Q4 net loss from continuing operations and includes $160.0 million cost for closure of Tampa, Fla., brewery. Net loss excludes $233.7 million or $0.46 a share loss from discontinued operations.
Excluding non-recurring items, Q4 1995 normalized profit from continuing operations was $137.0 million or $0.27 per fully diluted share.
(All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)
NOTE: Full-year 1996 revenues reflect gross sales before excise taxes of $1.74 billion vs year-ago taxes of $1.66 billion.
Full-year 1996 net sales $10.88 billion vs $10.34 billion.

Full-year 1996 profit from continuing operations includes $54.7 million gain on sale of St. Louis Cardinals National Baseball Club and Civic Center Corp, but excludes $33.8 million or $0.07 a share income from discontinued operations.
Full-year 1996 normalized income from continuing operations, excluding extraordinary items, $1.12 billion or $2.21 per fully diluted share.

Full-year 1995 profit from continuing operations includes $160.0 million cost for closure of Tampa brewery, but excludes loss from discontinued operations of $244.3 million or $0.48 a share primary and $0.47 fully diluted.
Full-year 1995 normalized income from continuing operations, excluding extraordinary items, $1.03 billion or $1.99 per fully diluted share.
